# A grove of far trees (parallax). Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Grove --base-color 0.294 0.412 0.184 --no-slot
add mesh ico-sphere --subdivisions 2 --radius 0.5 --name G0 --location -11.81 0 2.07

apply --location

delete only-faces
